body.prompt: A Korean woman in her late forties at a small school office, handing a white envelope to a shy high-school girl in uniform, a framed photo of an older woman on the desk between them, warm light, gentle smiles. Same painterly cinematic oil-painting texture and fine film grain, but a cool desaturated blue-grey palette with only one small warm light, horizontal 16:9 widescreen film frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame, faces clearly lit. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no readable screens, no watermark, no brands anywhere.
